<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (N‑S bond) from an aromatic amine and phenylsulfonyl chloride, breaking the S‑Cl bond. We'll search the template catalog with these bond criteria, then apply the found template to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor sets. Finally, we will format the precursors as a list of lists of SMILES strings.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl_chloride"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
